subject: Medford High School Building Project Kickoff
overview: The committee convened for its inaugural meeting to prepare for the MSBA eligibility phase of the high school building project. The body received legal training on transparency requirements and established subcommittees to manage communications, rules, and finance.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Training
items.summary: Janelle Austin from KP Law provided a briefing on Open Meeting Law and Public Records Law, emphasizing the risks of serial communication via email and the rules governing public participation.

items.title: Committee Member Introductions
items.summary: Members introduced themselves and discussed their roles on the committee, including representatives from city departments, the school district, and community residents with architectural and engineering expertise.

items.title: MSBA Process and Eligibility Phase Overview
items.summary: Chair Graham outlined the 270-day eligibility period starting May 1, which requires completion of an educational profile, maintenance documentation, and a feasibility study funding plan. The committee referred the question of co-locating Curtis Tufts High School to the Special Education and Behavioral Health Subcommittee for further study.

items.title: Subcommittee Formation and Assignments
items.summary: The body established subcommittees for Communications and Community Engagement, Rules and Onboarding, and Finance to address near-term deliverables before the next full committee meeting.

items.title: Administrative and Technology Updates
items.summary: Discussion focused on the launch of a dedicated project website and the logistical challenges of complying with Open Meeting Law during document drafting, which prohibits collaborative editing in shared drives.
